newsitem.title: USA: Basic Petroleum Intl to abandon well.
newsitem.headline: Basic Petroleum Intl to abandon well.

text.p: Basic Petroleum International Ltd said Thursday it had decided to abandon its Xan 12 well in northwest Guatemala after numerous unsuccessful attempts to recover a lost drilling assembly.

The company said the Xan 12 well encountered the Xan Dolomite zone at about 7,676 feet, which was lower than expected, and prior to reaching the lower boundary of the Xan Dolomite structure, the drill string parted, leaving a part of the drilling assembly in the well.
Basic Petroleum decided to abandon the well as a result of unsuccessful attempts to recover the lost drilling assembly and because the Xan Dolomite zone was too deep at this location.
The company said it had started drilling Xan 13, which has now reached a depth of 5,300 feet.
